name: Solver AI API Contract
description: Frontend-backend contract for the Solver AI college complaint management system. This contract reflects the currently implemented FastAPI backend in this project.
non_api_alias_note: The backend also exposes the same auth, complaint, admin, and student routers without the /api prefix. Frontend integration should use the /api-prefixed routes defined here.

authentication.student_token_storage: Frontend-managed; send token on authenticated student requests.
authentication.admin_token_storage: Frontend-managed; send token on authenticated admin requests.

frontend_rules: Do not implement ML inference in the frontend.
Do not send or display ML model files or training logic.
The backend performs category, urgency, duration, and affected-count inference when a complaint is submitted.
The student complaint form only needs complaint_text plus optional location fields for the planned simple UI.
The backend currently returns category_confidence and urgency_confidence, but the frontend should not require or display confidence values unless explicitly added later.
Use the exact status values returned by the backend. The backend currently supports Pending, Submitted, Under Review, In Progress, Resolved, Rejected, and Closed.
For the simple student UI, the primary visible lifecycle should be Pending/Submitted, In Progress, and Resolved/Closed.
Student registration is a three-step flow: request OTP, verify OTP, then create account.

student_registration_request_otp.description: Starts student registration and generates a registration OTP. The backend currently prints the OTP to its console for development/testing.

validation.email: Must be a valid email ending in @vitbhopal.ac.in.

student_registration_verify_otp.description: Verifies the OTP generated for student registration.

student_registration_create_account.description: Creates the student account after the email OTP has been verified.

validation.student_id: Exactly 10 alphanumeric characters. Backend normalizes it to uppercase.

student_login.description: Logs in a student using either email or student ID through the username field. The backend accepts email or username.

student_update_profile.description: Updates the student's name. Email is immutable.

student_dashboard_metrics.description: Returns student complaint counts and the four most recent complaints.

create_complaint.description: Creates a complaint and runs the backend AI/ML processing before saving it.

request.title: Optional short title
request.complaint_text: The water supply is not working in Block A.

minimal_frontend_request.complaint_text: The water supply is not working in Block A.

response.title: The water supply is not working in Block A.

create_complaint_alias.description: Alias of POST /complaints. Prefer POST /complaints for new frontend integration.

student_list_complaints.description: Returns all complaints belonging to the authenticated student.

student_get_complaint.description: Returns one complaint belonging to the authenticated student, including timeline history.

student_get_complaint_history.description: Returns status history for one complaint.

admin_dashboard.description: Returns admin dashboard counts, category/urgency breakdowns, and five recent complaints.

admin_list_complaints.description: Returns all complaints with optional filters and pagination.

admin_get_complaint.description: Returns full complaint details and status timeline. Anonymous complaints hide student identity.

admin_update_status.description: Changes the complaint status and records a ComplaintUpdate timeline entry.

admin_assign_department.description: Assigns a complaint to a supported department.

admin_analytics.description: Returns complaint totals, resolution rate, and category/urgency/department breakdowns.

admin_ai_insights.description: Returns backend-generated administrative insights based on stored complaints.

admin_related_complaints.description: Returns up to four related complaints based on matching building or category.

ml.description: ML inference is backend-only. The current backend uses category and urgency models plus context extraction for duration and affected_count.
ml.important: Do not create a frontend ML endpoint or duplicate model logic in JavaScript.

format.detail: Human-readable error message or structured error object
